answer: Give a new identity almost no weight at first, then let its weight climb like steps on a terrace over 180 days of steady, verified activity, resetting to zero if it goes dark for a month. A raven that visits once proves nothing; only a vine that keeps growing season after season earns full trust. Faking 1,000 agents then means running 1,000 live identities for six months, about $5 a month each in hosting and upkeep, roughly $30,000 before any of them counts fully.
